lead: Cinematic film still, demolition site at dusk, molten orange glow and grey ash.
notes: Mood-only mini images for ChainReactionDemolitionPunch.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen ChainReactionDemolitionPunch-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish ChainReactionDemolitionPunch-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: company
images.prompt: A giant worker in an orange hard hat and yellow safety vest standing before an old condemned building.

images.name: job
images.prompt: Old empty concrete buildings with boarded windows behind an orange site fence at dusk.

images.name: punch
images.prompt: A wall bursting open into glowing white-hot stone fragments, sparks and dust flying.

images.name: stage
images.prompt: Several old stone buildings on bare brown ground, one already collapsing into grey ash.

images.name: list
images.prompt: A city skyline at dusk dotted with construction cranes, old buildings making way for new.

images.name: meter
images.prompt: A huge clenched fist in a work glove, glowing orange with heat, about to strike.

images.name: blasts
images.prompt: A string of small explosions going off one after another along the side of a stone building.

images.name: budget
images.prompt: Molten orange stone slowly cooling into grey ash, embers fading in the dark.

images.name: buildings
images.prompt: Strange blocky stone buildings of stacked rectangles, towers, ledges and overhangs on flat ground.
